daily_thesis: The 2026-09-15 batch says embodied AI is moving from broad capability claims to permissioned evidence. Affordance and grounding papers ask whether a model knows the target part, the causal image region, and the action-sensitive semantics before it is allowed to act. Robot-learning papers then turn that diagnosis into deployment contracts: compact outcome states, feasibility critics, action-head alignment, tactile transfer, and metrological evidence gates decide what can authorize execution. Geometry papers make the same move for maps by separating tracking uncertainty, self-correction timing, aerial-ground anchoring, and radar/LiDAR evidence from visual fidelity alone. Video, document, and world-model papers expose the runtime version of the problem: more samples, frames, tokens, or retrieved pages matter only if selection converts them into answer or action value. APRL should build benchmarks where every latent, map, memory, or safety signal must prove which robot decision it is allowed to change.

clusters.cluster: Affordance evaluation moves from answer accuracy to evidence-specific action permission
clusters.why: 기존 VLM/VLA 평가는 맞은 답이나 최종 행동만 보고 모델이 근거를 제대로 썼다고 읽기 쉬웠다. 이번 묶음은 part identity, region intervention, semantic-action sensitivity, outcome-sufficient representation, and admissible inspection evidence를 따로 떼어 어느 증거가 실제 행동을 바꾸는지 묻는다. Part Grounding, GroundBench, CSGR, Outcome Bottlenecks, STAGE, and FRAME all turn grounding into a permission test rather than a score. APRL은 affordance benchmark에서 part, region, instruction semantics, compact state, and measurement provenance를 독립 변수로 두고 action flip과 invalid execution을 평가해야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: Six papers independently factorize part identity, visual region causality, semantic transfer, outcome state, and admissible evidence.
clusters.lab_action: LIBERO/tabletop inspection tasks에서 target-part swap, causal-region mask, instruction-only semantic swap, outcome-bottleneck size, and evidence-admissibility gate를 ablation하고 action flip, invalid execution, false accept, recovery success, and inspection coverage를 비교한다.

clusters.cluster: VLA deployment shifts from model scale to feasibility, latency, and physical-state gates
clusters.why: Robot foundation model 논의는 더 큰 backbone이나 더 많은 demonstration으로 흐르기 쉽지만, 배포에서는 어떤 상태가 실행을 허가하는지가 더 중요하다. clusters.cluster: Robot geometry becomes self-correcting map evidence under uncertainty and sensor mismatch
clusters.why: 3D/SLAM 평가는 여전히 reconstruction fidelity나 pose error 하나로 끝나기 쉽지만, 로봇에게 필요한 것은 어느 불확실성을 믿고 언제 map을 고칠지다. clusters.cluster: Efficient multimodal systems shift from keeping content to preserving decisive evidence
clusters.why: Long-video, chart, document, and safety VLM systems all face token or evidence budgets, but retaining more content is not the same as preserving the decisive cue. StepPrune learns a STOP action for visual tokens, plug-and-play keyframe selection compares frame selectors, temporal reliability suppression removes corrupted egocentric evidence, and EventGraph/EventField gives temporal reasoning inspectable structure. STEER, CAVR/VET, and SPARK push the same rule into charts, documents, and safety KV memory: every retained token or thread should explain which answer or refusal it supports. APRL should treat compression for robot agents as decisive-cue preservation under latency, not visual reconstruction.
clusters.confidence_note: Seven papers repeat evidence selection across visual tokens, keyframes, temporal events, structured charts, long documents, and safety KV memory.

clusters.cluster: Navigation and driving agents move from absolute commands to revocable commitments
clusters.why: Embodied navigation and driving fail when an agent turns a plausible language answer or state estimate into an irreversible command too early. LG-VLN orchestrates parsing, mapping, planning, execution, and recovery as a state graph; C2Nav asks the VLM to compare physically vetted alternatives before committing; HarnessVLN validates planner proposals against spatial evidence and failures. Belief-adaptive UAV navigation, Koopman/NMPC multi-robot navigation, semantic target navigation, and BLInD all make trust or intent distributions explicit before action. APRL은 waypoint, stop, recovery, and intent outputs를 absolute answer로 받지 말고 compare, revoke, and trust-update interfaces로 바꾸어 failure lead time을 재야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: Navigation, UAV, multi-robot, ASV, and driving papers all expose commitment authority under uncertainty.
clusters.lab_action: R2R-CE/ObjectNav/UAV/driving scenarios에서 absolute waypoint, comparative gaze choice, route-sketch memory, GNSS trust belief, multi-robot uncertainty, and blind intent distribution을 바꿔 wrong-turn rate, stop error, recovery latency, collision proxy, and false-positive intervention을 비교한다.

frontier_memory.label: Strengthening
frontier_memory.history: September 14 framed robotics as evidence-interface authorization across action, maps, memory, and safety.
frontier_memory.body: September 15 strengthens that line with counterfactual affordance grounding, outcome bottlenecks, safety reachability, and compare-before-commit navigation.

frontier_memory.label: New signal
frontier_memory.history: Recent geometry notes emphasized relocalization, chained SLAM, and map governance.
frontier_memory.body: Today adds self-correcting streaming geometry and uncertainty-decoupled 3DGS SLAM, making correction timing part of the map interface.

frontier_memory.label: Commoditizing
frontier_memory.history: Long-video and MLLM work repeatedly argues for more frames, more tokens, or larger context.
frontier_memory.body: The stronger signal is selection value: keyframe selectors, token pruners, and test-time sampling must prove which retained evidence changes the answer or action.

frontier_memory.label: Contradiction
frontier_memory.history: More generated candidates and richer visual representations are often treated as monotonic improvements.
frontier_memory.body: CVA reports oracle headroom without reliable selection gain, and affordance papers show visual region supply can be less useful than category identity shortcuts.

frontier_memory.label: Missing axis
frontier_memory.history: The repo has separate threads for VLA safety, embodied navigation, and 3D map uncertainty.
frontier_memory.body: A unified permission benchmark should ask when evidence may change action, map update, navigation stop, or safety recovery under the same episode.

strategy_board.title: Permission-gated embodied evidence benchmark
strategy_board.thesis: Create tasks where part grounding, semantic transfer, outcome bottlenecks, safety critics, and metrological evidence must justify exactly which robot action they authorize.
strategy_board.one_week: Prototype three LIBERO or tabletop counterfactuals with target-part swaps, instruction-only semantic swaps, and compact outcome-state ablations.
strategy_board.four_week: Add ShieldVLA-style feasibility gates, tactile/dexterous perturbations, and inspection admissibility logs across manipulation and mobile-manipulation tasks.
strategy_board.success: Evidence gates predict or change action choice, recovery, and safety violations better than terminal success, VLM confidence, or reconstruction scores.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if evidence gates collapse to category priors or do not alter policy behavior under counterfactual interventions.
strategy_board.asset: Part-swap images, action-sensitivity labels, outcome-state latents, feasibility traces, tactile perturbations, and recovery annotations.

strategy_board.title: Self-correcting robot geometry protocol
strategy_board.thesis: Evaluate 3DGS-SLAM and streaming geometry models by uncertainty separation, correction timing, and downstream navigation recovery.
strategy_board.one_week: Run a small dynamic-scene sequence with camera jerk, moving objects, weak texture, and delayed loop evidence, then score pose, map, and recovery separately.
strategy_board.four_week: Compare SCOUT-style dual uncertainty, SURE-style multi-timescale correction, aerial-ground anchors, UAV localization, and radar-LiDAR fusion under shared map-change episodes.
strategy_board.success: Correction and uncertainty metrics predict wrong-pose, wrong-map-update, and navigation-recovery failures before visual reconstruction quality does.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if correction improves only ATE or rendering while downstream navigation and localization decisions are unchanged.
strategy_board.asset: Dynamic mapping sequences, uncertainty traces, loop-closure timing, map-update decisions, and robot task outcome labels.

strategy_board.title: Selection-value audit for world models and multimodal agents
strategy_board.thesis: Unify compute-value audits, token pruning, keyframe selection, evidence threading, C2Nav comparisons, and grounded reasoning-to-action into one decision-value test.
strategy_board.one_week: Measure whether token, frame, rollout, and comparison choices change answers or actions on a small robot-video QA and navigation set.
strategy_board.four_week: Charge full compute cost for candidate generation, verification, VLM comparison, and trajectory decoding while tracking action-value improvement.
strategy_board.success: Selection policies beat uniform compute or naive context by net action value, not only by answer accuracy or oracle headroom.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if selected evidence improves offline scores but fails to change trajectories, stopping, recovery, or safety decisions.
strategy_board.asset: Candidate pools, verifier scores, keyframe/token selections, comparison logs, trajectory deltas, and compute-cost ledgers.
